mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the skin to the body was most worthwhile: it brought protection, sweat, nerves and blood vessels together and showed how the same skin responds to temperature.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sweat gland and nerve endings was clear but a little repetitive once the named slots appeared.

surprise.text: I learned that the outer layer has no blood vessels of its own; its living cells receive supplies from deeper tissue.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The pictures and named slots explained the pairings, although the final warm-and-cool responses appeared without being built separately.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting familiar body parts and seeing how their structures work together was satisfying, especially in the final skin model.
